features: Bespoke furniture designed by Neville Johnson
Great Transport Links including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
A fabulous opportunity to live in the iconic Barbican Arts Centre building, which was partially converted into residential apartments in 2010. This beautifully presented three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment is situated on the 8th floor in a quiet location overlooking the Sculpture Court.
The apartment opens into a spacious glazed entrance hall with a large storage cupboard and offers well-proportioned rooms throughout.
The generous living room and open-plan kitchen feature bespoke furniture designed and installed by Neville Johnson. Full height, full width windows and a glass sliding door lead onto a balcony with shutters, overlooking the Sculpture Court.
The principal bedroom also enjoys full height, full width windows and a glass sliding door opening onto the balcony with shutters, together with a fitted wardrobe and an en-suite shower room with mirrored storage cabinets.
Bedroom two, currently arranged as a study, benefits from bespoke fitted shelving designed by Neville Johnson and has full height, full width windows and a glass sliding door opening onto the balcony, again overlooking the Sculpture Court.
Bedroom three includes a large fitted wardrobe providing excellent storage.
The spacious family bathroom has mirrored storage cabinets and a large cupboard housing the washer/dryer.
There are three lifts serving the Crescent. Residents enjoy access to the beautifully maintained Barbican gardens, while the 24-hour car park attendants can receive parcels and hold keys. Car parking is available by separate negotiation with the City of London.
Please note that, under the terms of the head lease, pets are not permitted
Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlain, Powell & Bon, the Grade II Barbican Estate is home to the world-famous Barbican Arts Centre, offering three cinemas, an art gallery, concert hall, theatres, restaurants, bars and cafés. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away. Also in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are all within easy walking distance. No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated £6,721 (1 April 2026 – 31 March 2027)
Lease: 150 years from 2010
Ground Rent: £150 per annum
